test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the denotation of the highlighted word 'fragile'.

The **fragile **economy needs some thrust from supporting partners.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Frail**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fragile** means **very weak**.

 
 
• **Example:** *This bag is full of **fragile** articles. *
 
 
 
• **Frail **means **weak or unhealthy**. 
 
 
• **Example:** *Tim looks frail after his surgery. *
 
 
 
• Therefore the appropriate option is "frail".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Robust** - healthy and vigorous.

 
 
• **Example: ***The fruit platter looks **robust**. *
 
 
 
• **Strong** - full of strength.
 
 
• **Example:** *John's counterattacks were **strong**. *
 
 
 
• **Trail **- a path 
 
 
• **Example: ***The farmer left a** trail **of grains as he carried the sacks. *
